thread:
Anya: evening handoff — quick summary before I head off, + primary/secondary and outstanding actions
Anya: Primary: Anya (until 21:00 PT). Secondary: Devin (on-call for escalation).
Anya: What happened: we had two small pages this afternoon: 1) p95 latency spike on /v1/generate (region eu-west) around 17:52, 2) embedding worker retries causing backlog on the embeddings autoscaler at ~18:40. Customer impact: transient slow responses for a small subset of requests (~1% of traffic) and delayed embedding returns for low-priority jobs. No SLO breaches yet but p95 nudged toward 3.8s briefly.
incident-bot: PAGE: /v1/generate p95 spike detected — AlertID=INC-2026-18495-01 — triggered at 2026-06-14T17:52:18Z — severity=sev2 — runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-spike
Devin: saw the alert, dug into router traces — root cause looks like a combination of a small batcher thrash + one GPU node (gpu-12) with noisy fan causing thermal throttling and a KV cache miss storm for certain customer prefixes.
Mateo: I validated: gpu-12 hosts batcher pod batcher-eu-3. CPU fine, but GPU util jumped and p99 latency correlated with that host. I drained it temporarily at 18:05 and that brought p95 down.
Sasha: embeddings backlog: autoscaler scaled fine but there were repeated retries from an older embed-client version producing 429s; we blackholed that IP pool to stop the retry storm.
Anya: mitigation summary: drained gpu-12 (scheduled reboot by infra), evictions reduced KV pressure, disabled old embed client via IP ACLs, increased batcher concurrency by +10% for eu-west as short-term relief.
Anya: Current status: latency nominal, embedding queue draining at ~60/s (down from 200/s). No open customer pages.
Devin: action item I opened: GH-ops #3124 — add a soft-rate-limit on client retries for embeds (to avoid full retry storms). ETA: tomorrow EOD.
Mateo: infra is replacing the suspect GPU node (ticket INFRA-987). ETA for node replacement: 2026-06-15 03:00 UTC. Node will be offlined and hardware inspected.
Sasha: I'm keeping an eye on customer-facing dashboards and will post any regressions. If the embed drain rate drops below 25/s for >30m, escalate.
ops-rotations-bot: Reminder: handoff checklist — confirm prim/sec, runbook links, outstanding pages, outstanding infra tickets.
Anya: Runbooks and links for incoming shifts:
- Latency spike runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-spike
- Embeddings retry runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-backlog
- Eviction/kv pressure guide: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-eviction
Devin: quick commands if you need them (use with care):
```
# drain suspect batcher host
kubectl cordon gpu-12 && kubectl drain node/gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
# check router traces for prefix
curl -s "https://observability/api/traces?service=router&filter=prefix:customer-123" | jq .summary
```
Mateo: If you need to force a soft-failover for heavy routes: update routing policy (ops-router) to route region->fallback model variant (low-cost) for 10m window. Ping me before doing this.
Sasha: Customer comms: No external incident created yet. If we see >2 repeated regressions or embedding drain <20/s for 45m, I'll draft a short note and tag support.
Anya: Outstanding action items before handoff:
- Devin: follow up on GH-ops #3124 (soft retry limiter) — due 2026-06-15 EOD
- Mateo: coordinate with infra for node replacement completion and post-mortem notes — INFRA-987
- Sasha: monitor dashboards and prepare customer note if we regress — oncall -> support channel watch
- Anya: I will upload a short post-incident checklist into the incident tracker and attach traces.
Devin: small follow-up — we should add an automated detector to identify noisy GPU hosts (thermal/perf outliers) and auto-evacuate pods; will prototype next sprint.
Anya: handoff timing: I leave at 21:00 PT — Devin will be primary after that and Mateo secondary for infra coordination.
Devin: acknowledged, I'll keep the channel open and update at 00:00 PT if anything changes. If anyone gets a page, ping @Devin and @Mateo immediately.
Sasha: +1, will keep watch and log any customer-facing notes. Good handoff, thanks. :thumbsup:
Anya: leaving notes pinned: runbook links, GH-ops #3124 link, INFRA-987. Thanks team, see you tomorrow.
